# I Am Image Salon

> Black-owned, woman-owned full-service hair salon in Portland, Oregon's Northwest District since July 5, 2011. Owner: Kayla Means. Serves women, men and children of every hair type.

- Address: 1500 NW 18th Ave, Suite 104 (inside ActivSpace on Raleigh), Portland, OR 97209
- Phone: (503) 224-0399 · Email: kaylameans@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon, Tue, Thu 10 AM–8 PM; Wed closed; Fri 10 AM–5 PM; Sat 8:30 AM–5 PM; Sun closed
- Services: locs (starter, retwist, sister locs, interlocking, detox, repair, soft & mermaid locs), braids (knotless, box, Fulani, boho, stitch, feed-in, crochet, twists), Cécred silk press & treatments, color & cuts, sew-ins/quick weaves/wig installs, relaxers & perms, barber (fades, line ups, men's facials), kids braids
- Rating: 5.0 on Google (37 reviews, October 2026)
